"""Adapter historico atomico para dbo.Sync_Sales.

Aislado de los sincronizadores protegidos de Ventas del Dia y Ventas Cerradas.
Resuelve el POS con PosRuntimeResolver y reutiliza unicamente el backfill historico
existente de Sync_Sales para extraccion/carga idempotente.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import time
from datetime import timedelta
from typing import Any, Dict, Mapping

from core.connections.pos_runtime_resolver import resolve_pos_runtime_context
from core.system_type_utils import is_mpro_system, is_softrestaurant_system


def _runtime_config(runtime) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    host = (
        f"{runtime.host}\\{runtime.instance}"
        if runtime.instance
        else runtime.host
    )
    return {
        "host": host,
        "port": runtime.port,
        "database": runtime.database,
        "username": runtime.username,
        "password": runtime.password,
        "system_type": runtime.system_type,
        "sucursal_origen_id": runtime.sucursal_origen_id,
    }


async def execute_comercial_ventas_detalle(
    context: Mapping[str, Any],
) -> Dict[str, Any]:
    from scripts import pilot_backfill_sync_sales as backfill

    started = time.monotonic()
    unit_code = str(context.get("UnidadCodigo") or "").strip().upper()
    if not unit_code:
        return {"success": False, "error_message": "UNIT_CODE_MISSING"}

    runtime = resolve_pos_runtime_context(unit_code)
    expected_connection = str(context.get("ConexionID") or "").strip().lower()
    if str(runtime.server_id).strip().lower() != expected_connection:
        return {
            "success": False,
            "error_message": "UNIT_CONFIG_CONNECTION_MISMATCH",
        }

    start = context.get("FechaInicio")
    end = context.get("FechaFin")
    if start is None or end is None:
        return {"success": False, "error_message": "DATE_RANGE_MISSING"}

    # El backfill historico usa fin exclusivo; la unidad atomica persiste fin
    # inclusivo, por eso se avanza un dia sin ampliar el scope del bloque.
    fi = start.isoformat()
    ff = (end + timedelta(days=1)).isoformat()
    cfg = _runtime_config(runtime)

    if is_mpro_system(runtime.system_type):
        rows = backfill.extract_mpro_twopass(cfg, fi, ff)
    elif is_softrestaurant_system(runtime.system_type):
        rows = backfill.extract_softrestaurant_twopass(cfg, fi, ff)
    else:
        return {
            "success": False,
            "error_message": "SYSTEM_NOT_SUPPORTED_FOR_SALES_DETAIL",
        }

    for row in rows:
        row["UnidadNegocio"] = unit_code

    metrics = backfill.load_to_sync_sales(
        rows,
        unit_code,
        fi,
        ff,
        bool(context.get("IsDryRun")),
    )
    error = str(metrics.get("error") or "").strip()
    processed = int(metrics.get("tickets_extraidos") or len(rows) or 0)
    inserted = int(metrics.get("inserted") or 0)

    return {
        "success": not bool(error),
        "records_processed": processed,
        "records_inserted": inserted,
        "records_updated": 0,
        "records_errored": 1 if error else 0,
        "duration_seconds": int(max(0, time.monotonic() - started)),
        "warning_message": (
            f"duplicados={int(metrics.get('tickets_duplicados') or 0)}"
        ),
        "error_message": error or None,
    }

SET NOCOUNT ON;
SET XACT_ABORT ON;

BEGIN TRY
    BEGIN TRANSACTION;

    IF OBJECT_ID('dbo.Sistema_Sync_Catalogo','U') IS NULL
        THROW 51000, 'SYNC_HISTORICAL_DETAIL_MISSING_CATALOG', 1;
    IF OBJECT_ID('dbo.Sistema_Sync_Capacidades','U') IS NULL
        THROW 51000, 'SYNC_HISTORICAL_DETAIL_MISSING_BINDINGS', 1;

    /*
      Capability historica de detalle de ventas.
      Aditiva: no modifica ni reutiliza los sincronizadores protegidos de
      Ventas del Dia / Ventas Cerradas. El runtime atomico usa el backfill
      historico de dbo.Sync_Sales.
    */
    UPDATE dbo.Sistema_Sync_Catalogo
       SET CategoriaCodigo='VENTAS',
           EntidadCodigo='VENTA_DETALLE',
           CampoFecha='FechaHora',
           ClaveNegocio=N'["UnidadNegocio","NumeroTicket","FechaHora"]',
           Handler='backfill_sync_sales',
           HandlerImplementado=1,
           SoportaIncremental=1,
           SoportaFullSync=1,
           SoportaResume=1,
           SoportaSafeStop=1,
           VersionContrato='historical-detail-v1',
           MetadataJSON=N'{"chunk_unit":"day","max_attempts":3,"retry_backoff_seconds":15,"atomic_boundary":"unit-capability-day"}'
     WHERE Codigo='comercial_ventas_detalle'
       AND ISNULL(Activo,1)=1
       AND ISNULL(PermiteResync,0)=1;

    IF @@ROWCOUNT <> 1
        THROW 51000, 'SYNC_HISTORICAL_DETAIL_CATALOG_ROW_MISSING', 1;

    INSERT INTO dbo.Sistema_Sync_Capacidades
        (CodigoSync, SistemaCapacidadID, Obligatoria, Activo)
    SELECT
        'comercial_ventas_detalle',
        cap.SistemaCapacidadID,
        1,
        1
    FROM dbo.Sistema_Capacidades cap
    JOIN dbo.Sistema_Tipos st
      ON st.SistemaTipoID=cap.SistemaTipoID
    WHERE cap.CodigoCapacidad='SYNC_VENTAS_HISTORICAS'
      AND ISNULL(cap.Activo,1)=1
      AND ISNULL(st.Activo,1)=1
      AND st.CodigoSistema IN ('MPRO','SOFTRESTAURANT_PRO')
      AND NOT EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM dbo.Sistema_Sync_Capacidades link
          WHERE link.CodigoSync='comercial_ventas_detalle'
            AND link.SistemaCapacidadID=cap.SistemaCapacidadID
      );

    IF (
        SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT st.CodigoSistema)
        FROM dbo.Sistema_Sync_Capacidades link
        JOIN dbo.Sistema_Capacidades cap
          ON cap.SistemaCapacidadID=link.SistemaCapacidadID
        JOIN dbo.Sistema_Tipos st
          ON st.SistemaTipoID=cap.SistemaTipoID
        WHERE link.CodigoSync='comercial_ventas_detalle'
          AND ISNULL(link.Activo,1)=1
          AND cap.CodigoCapacidad='SYNC_VENTAS_HISTORICAS'
          AND ISNULL(cap.Activo,1)=1
          AND ISNULL(st.Activo,1)=1
          AND st.CodigoSistema IN ('MPRO','SOFTRESTAURANT_PRO')
    ) <> 2
        THROW 51000, 'SYNC_HISTORICAL_DETAIL_BINDINGS_INCOMPLETE', 1;

    COMMIT TRANSACTION;
END TRY
BEGIN CATCH
    IF XACT_STATE() <> 0 ROLLBACK TRANSACTION;
    THROW;
END CATCH;

from datetime import date
from pathlib import Path

from modules.sync_historicos.planner import build_historical_plan

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
FRONT = ROOT.parent / "frontend/src/pages/SyncHistorical.jsx"

ADAPTER = ROOT / "modules/sync_historicos/comercial_detail_adapter.py"
MIGRATION = ROOT / "database/migrations/20261014_001_sync_historical_comercial_detalle.sql"


def _cap(system_code, system_id, capability_id):
    return {
        "eligible_for_historical": True,
        "system_code": system_code,
        "system_id": system_id,
        "system_capability_id": capability_id,
        "capability_key": "comercial_ventas_detalle",
        "category_key": "VENTAS",
        "category_name": "Comercial",
        "entity_key": "VENTA_DETALLE",
        "handler": "backfill_sync_sales",
        "date_field": "FechaHora",
        "business_key": ["UnidadNegocio", "NumeroTicket", "FechaHora"],
        "dependencias": [],
        "execution_order": 10,
        "supports_resume": True,
        "supports_safe_stop": True,
        "version": "historical-detail-v1",
        "metadata": {
            "chunk_unit": "day",
            "max_attempts": 3,
            "retry_backoff_seconds": 15,
        },
    }


def _unit(code, system_code, system_id, suffix):
    return {
        "unit_id": f"11111111-1111-1111-1111-{suffix}",
        "unit_code": code,
        "connection_id": f"22222222-2222-2222-2222-{suffix}",
        "system_id": system_id,
        "system_code": system_code,
        "system_version_id": None,
        "branch_id": system_id,
        "branch_origin_id": str(system_id),
        "company_id": system_id,
    }


def test_visual_grouping_uses_canonical_group_not_category_code():
    text = CATALOG.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    assert 'display_category_key = "GROUP::" + category_name.upper()' in text
    assert "if category_key" not in text


def test_frontend_allows_partial_system_compatibility():
    text = FRONT.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    assert "effectiveSystems.some" in text
    assert "partiallyCompatible" in text
    assert "planner ejecutará solo las sucursales válidas" in text
    assert "No compatible con toda la selección" not in text


def test_planner_keeps_only_valid_atomic_units_for_partial_compatibility():
    plan = build_historical_plan(
        start=date(2026, 1, 1),
        end=date(2026, 1, 1),
        selected_systems=["MPRO", "SOFTRESTAURANT_PRO"],
        selected_units=["MPRO-A", "SOFT-A"],
        selected_capabilities=["comercial_ventas_detalle"],
        registry=[_cap("MPRO", 2, 21)],
        unit_contexts=[
            _unit("MPRO-A", "MPRO", 2, "000000000001"),
            _unit("SOFT-A", "SOFTRESTAURANT_PRO", 1, "000000000002"),
        ],
        correlation_id="33333333-3333-3333-3333-333333333333",
    )
    assert len(plan.atomic_units) == 1
    assert plan.atomic_units[0].system_code == "MPRO"
    assert plan.atomic_units[0].unit_code == "MPRO-A"


def test_detail_adapter_is_isolated_from_protected_sales_syncs():
    text = ADAPTER.read_text(encoding="utf-8").lower()
    assert "resolve_pos_runtime_context" in text
    assert "pilot_backfill_sync_sales" in text
    assert "sync_comercial_abiertas_v2" not in text
    assert "sync_softrestaurant_ventas_cerradas" not in text
    assert "sync_mpro_ventas_cerradas" not in text
    assert "_ejecutar_sync_real" not in text


def test_detail_migration_binds_both_current_systems_without_touching_protected_syncs():
    text = MIGRATION.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    assert "comercial_ventas_detalle" in text
    assert "SYNC_VENTAS_HISTORICAS" in text
    assert "'MPRO','SOFTRESTAURANT_PRO'" in text
    lower = text.lower()
    assert "sync_comercial_abiertas_v2" not in lower
    assert "sync_softrestaurant_ventas_cerradas" not in lower
    assert "sync_mpro_ventas_cerradas" not in lower
